bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test -n "${HTTPS_PROXY:-}${https_proxy:-}${HTTP_PROXY:-}${http_proxy:-}" || exit 61
nodejs='import {setDefaultResultOrder} from "node:dns";setDefaultResultOrder("ipv4first");try{const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(9000)});process.exitCode=r.status<500?0:1}catch{process.exitCode=1}'
if docker run --rm --network deploy_default --pull never --read-only --cap-drop ALL --env HTTPS_PROXY --env https_proxy --env HTTP_PROXY --env http_proxy --env NO_PROXY --env no_proxy -e NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 --entrypoint node create-videobot:local-poll --input-type=module -e "$nodejs" >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_PROXY_EGRESS_ON_DB_NET=PASS
 exit 0
fi
if docker run --rm --network host --pull never --read-only --cap-drop ALL --env HTTPS_PROXY --env https_proxy --env HTTP_PROXY --env http_proxy --env NO_PROXY --env no_proxy -e NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 --entrypoint node create-videobot:local-poll --input-type=module -e "$nodejs" >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_PROXY_EGRESS_ON_HOST_NET=PASS
 exit 80
fi
exit 81
